language_desc: Choose the interface language — saved permanently to your account
receiptsSubtitle: Full control over receipt layout and printing behavior — settings are saved per pharmacy and apply on every device.
pharmacyNameDesc: If the pharmacy is registered under your personal name, pick a prefix shown before the name in the receipt header — or type your own.
customPrefixPlaceholder: Or type a custom prefix — e.g. El-Nour Pharmacies
paperSizeDesc: Choose the paper width for your thermal printer — the template reflows automatically.
paper80Desc: The most common standard — comfortable columns and one-line drug names
paper58Desc: Smaller and cheaper — items wrap onto two lines
printModeDesc: When should the print window open after checkout?
printModeAutoDesc: The print window opens right after saving — the cashier just confirms
printModeManualDesc: A success message with a “Print receipt” button appears — print on demand
contentDesc: Show or hide sections as you need — the side preview updates instantly.
copiesDesc: Printed one after the other on the same paper with a cut line
returnPolicyPlaceholder: Returns within 14 days with the original receipt
guaranteeDesc: Three one-time steps on the cashier device, and every receipt comes out perfectly aligned.
guaranteeStep1Before: Set the thermal printer as the
guaranteeStep2Before: In the printer-driver preferences, create a
guaranteeStep3After: above and check alignment and cutting.
silentPrintTitle: For fully silent printing (no confirmation) — optional:
silentPrintHint: Run Chrome with this shortcut on the cashier device only — the print window passes silently to the default printer.
previewDesc: At the real paper width ({width} mm)
savedFlash: Settings saved and applied on every device
livePreviewHint: Any form change updates the preview instantly before saving
databaseSubtitle: Database schema status and applied migration history — full transparency of structural changes.
schemaStatusDesc: Migrations apply automatically at startup following global best practices: an advisory lock prevents parallel execution, one transaction per migration (all succeed or all fail), and a permanent reference history prevents duplicates.
historyDesc: Newest first — the sequence matches the actual application order on the database.
autoMigrationsNote: When new features are added, numbered migrations join the chain and apply to your database automatically on update — with no manual steps and no data loss.
importSubtitle: Import legacy-program items from a spreadsheet file (xlsx Excel or CSV) — preview, column mapping, and a detailed report before and after the import.
fieldPartialPriceHint: For strip-sold products — derived automatically if left empty
fieldUnitsPerBoxHint: 2 or more means the product sells by strip
nameColumnRequired: The product-name column must be mapped before executing
uploadDesc: Accepts Excel xlsx or CSV — up to {rows} rows and 10 MB. Empty rows are skipped automatically.
dropHere: Drag the file here or click to browse
firstRowHint: The first row in the file must be the header row
templateHint: Don’t have the file in the right format? Download our ready template and fill it with your data.
mappingDesc: The system suggested a mapping automatically — adjust anything and validity is re-estimated instantly.
duplicateSkip: Skip it and keep its current data
duplicateUpdate: Update its prices and reorder level from the file
duplicateNote: Updating never touches existing stock or packaging type.
doneDesc: All valid rows were imported in one transaction — any unexpected failure means nothing changed.
stockLinesNote: {rows} opening stock lines added with batch “IMPORT”.
rejectedDesc: Fix these rows in your file and import them again in a new session.
